fields.actionsImplemented: Actions implemented (as reported by the department)
fields.name: Name
fields.title: Title

evidenceSupport.partly: The evidence supports part of it
evidenceSupport.no: The evidence does not support it

dashboard.title: Audit dashboard
dashboard.description: Findings by status, year, department, priority and report type; trends, ageing, closure rate, repeat and risk-accepted findings.

department.title: My department's audits
department.description: Audit reports and findings of {{units}} and the units you may see — for information.
department.readOnly: Read-only: the Audit Office records every follow-up, status and comment.

scope.section: You see the findings of your own unit and the units below it.
scope.department: You see the findings of your department and every unit below it.

department.noDue: Nothing due in the next 30 days.

reports.title: Audit reports
reports.description: Internal and external audit reports, special and revenue audits, consultancies — with their findings.
reports.newHint: The report holds its findings, dates, file and distribution list.

report.draftHint: Draft: departments do not see this report until it is issued.
report.noFindings: No findings yet — add them by form, Excel import or AI extraction.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: Every finding you may see, with status, completion and the latest Audit Office comment.

finding.cancelHint: The finding and its open recommendations are cancelled with the reason and kept in the history.
finding.documentLinked: A Document Registry document is linked.
finding.readOnlyHint: The Audit Office records follow-ups, status and comments for this finding.

recommendation.dueHint: No default: set the date agreed for this recommendation.
recommendation.reviseHint: The original date is kept; the new date and the reason are logged.
recommendation.acceptRiskHint: Management decided not to implement; the justification and reference are recorded and reported separately.

followUp.title: Record follow-up — {{number}}
followUp.hint: Record what the department reported and the evidence received.
followUp.evidenceHint: Describe the evidence; upload the files on the Evidence tab after saving.
followUp.evidenceFile: Evidence file for the AI review (optional)
followUp.evidenceAfter: Evidence files are attached to the follow-up on the Evidence tab.

risks.title: Linked risks and controls
risks.linkHint: Optionally flag the risk for reassessment and lower the linked control's effectiveness.
risks.lower: Lower the control's effectiveness one level

import.title: Import findings (Excel)
import.hint: One row per recommendation; rows with the same finding ref form one finding. Nothing is saved while any row is invalid.

ai.extractHint: Upload the report (PDF, Word or scan) or paste its text. The AI proposes drafts; nothing is saved until you confirm.
ai.reviewHint: Review each draft, keep the ones you want, set the responsible department and the due date, then confirm.

calendar.title: Follow-up calendar
calendar.description: Next follow-up dates and due dates of open recommendations, by auditor.

settings.title: Audit management
settings.description: Department visibility, notices, follow-up review, reminders and integrations. The full audit lifecycle (layer 2) is switched in Settings → Features.

scope.section: Their section only (and units below it)

scopeHint.section: Directors see their department and its sections; staff of a section see their section.
scopeHint.department: Staff of a section also see their department's and sibling sections' findings — never another department's.

settings.departmentLevelCode: Organisation level that counts as department
settings.notifyDepartments: Notify departments when a finding concerning them is created, updated or closed
settings.followUpReview: Internal review of follow-ups (auditor → Chief Audit Executive)
settings.followUpReviewHint: Off by default. When on, a follow-up applies only after the review is approved.
settings.reminderWorkingDays: Count reminder days as working days
settings.capObservations: Improvement observations to the corrective action plan

capMode.manual: The Audit Office may send them

settings.kpiHint: Publish audit measures as machine drafts on KPI cards (the KPI owner submits them). Leave empty to not publish.

lifecycle.off: The full audit lifecycle is switched off
lifecycle.offHint: An administrator can switch it on in Settings → Features.
lifecycle.universeHint: Auditable entities from the organisation and Risk Management, with inherent rating and risk score.
lifecycle.universeEmpty: The universe is empty — pull it from the organisation and Risk Management.
lifecycle.plansHint: Risk-based plans approved by the audit committee, with QAIP measures.
lifecycle.teamHint: An existing team from the Teams module.
lifecycle.workPapers: Programme and working papers ({{reviewed}} of {{count}} reviewed)
lifecycle.workPapersPrivate: Working papers are visible to the Audit Office only.

currentStatus.open: Open — follow-ups recorded by the Audit Office
currentStatus.late: Late — a recommendation passed its due date ({{pct}} % achieved)
currentStatus.noRecommendations: Add the recommendations of this finding
currentStatus.closed: Closed — every recommendation is completed, risk accepted or cancelled

errors.invalidTransition: This action is not possible in the current status.
errors.notEditable: This record can no longer be changed.
errors.reportClosed: The audit report is closed or cancelled.
errors.followUpInFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.nextFollowUpRequired: The next follow-up date is required below 100 %.
errors.nextFollowUpAfter: The next follow-up must be after the follow-up date.
errors.dueDateRequired: Each recommendation needs its own due date.
errors.useRevision: Use "Revise due date" to change the date of a followed-up recommendation.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
errors.reviewPending: A follow-up of this recommendation is waiting review.
errors.capNotAllowed: Only improvement observations of an issued report can be sent to the corrective action plan.
errors.planExists: A plan already exists for this year.
errors.planNotEditable: The plan can no longer be changed.
errors.planEmpty: Add engagements before submitting the plan.
errors.findingsOpen: The report still has open findings.
errors.workPaperNotPrepared: Mark the working paper prepared first.
errors.selfReview: The reviewer must be someone other than the preparer.
